messages.en: We're nearly at the border, right?
Yeah, according to the map, we're only ten minutes away.

senses.en_definition: Perfect; free from faults or flaws.
Complete; having all the necessary parts or provisions.
Properly arranged or carried out; orderly and effective.
Successfully completed or brought to a satisfactory conclusion.
Excellent or ideally suited to a particular purpose or situation.

messages.en: I haven't sent the slides to the group yet. I feel like they don't look quite good enough, so I want to tweak them a bit more.
You don't have to wait until they're perfect. Just send the draft first, and we can go through it together later.
Fair point. Okay, I'll send them now. Let me know if anything's unclear, yeah?
Is everyone in the meeting room yet?
Yes, boss. Everyone's in and ready now.

senses.en_definition: Everyone or everything in the group or set referred to; all of them.
In total; taken as a whole or in its entirety.

collocations.en: how much is it all together?

messages.en: Is it only RM30 in total, including drinks? I want to transfer you my share.
Yeah, RM30 for the two of us. Just transfer me RM15. I've already paid.
